name: Din
title: Goddess of Power
description: One of the three Golden Goddesses who descended upon the chaos that would become Hyrule, using her strong flaming arms to cultivate the land and give the world its red earth.

name: Nayru
title: Goddess of Wisdom
description: One of the three Golden Goddesses, who poured her wisdom onto the world to give it the laws of order that still govern it today.

name: Farore
title: Goddess of Courage
description: One of the three Golden Goddesses, whose rich soul produced the life forms who would uphold the laws set by her sisters, before all three departed and left behind the Triforce.

name: Hylia
title: The Goddess of the Surface
description: The goddess who guarded the Triforce and the surface world against Demise's demon army, and who ultimately sealed a portion of her own divine spirit within a mortal bloodline, becoming the ancestor of Princess Zelda across every age.

name: Demise
title: The Demon King
description: The progenitor of all evil in Hyrule, who led a demon army against Hylia and the surface-dwellers in a war for the Triforce and, upon his defeat by the first incarnation of Link, cursed his hatred to be reborn forever to pursue the goddess's bloodline and the hero's descendants.

name: Ganondorf
title: The King of Evil
description: The sole male born to the Gerudo in a century and their king, whose lust for the Triforce and reincarnated hatred of Demise leads him to seize the Triforce of Power and, in his monstrous beast form Ganon, wage war on Hyrule across generations.

name: Link
title: The Hero of Hyrule
description: The silent, spirited protagonist of the series, a young Hylian repeatedly chosen by the goddess Hylia and the Master Sword to defend Hyrule from Ganon and other threats, reincarnated across many ages bearing the Triforce of Courage.

name: Princess Zelda
title: Princess of Hyrule
description: The princess of Hyrule and mortal reincarnation of the goddess Hylia, entrusted with the Triforce of Wisdom, who works alongside Link in each age to protect Hyrule from Ganon and often bears great personal sacrifice to do so.

name: Impa
title: Guardian of the Royal Family
description: A member of the Sheikah tribe sworn to protect the royal family of Hyrule, appearing across incarnations as Zelda's nursemaid, guardian, and closest advisor, most famously raising Zelda in hiding at Kakariko Village in Ocarina of Time.

name: Navi
title: The Fairy Companion
description: A fairy sent by the Great Deku Tree to guide the young Kokiri boy Link, accompanying him throughout his quest in Ocarina of Time and famously urging him to look, listen, and pay attention.

name: Midna
title: The True Princess of the Twilight Realm
description: The rightful princess of the Twilight Realm, cursed into an imp-like form by the usurper Zant, who allies with Link to restore both their worlds, wielding the fragments of the Fused Shadows before ultimately shattering the Mirror of Twilight to seal the two realms apart.

name: Fi
title: Spirit of the Goddess Sword
description: The spirit residing within the Goddess Sword, created by Hylia to guide her chosen hero, who serves as Link's precise and dispassionate companion throughout Skyward Sword before returning to slumber within the newly forged Master Sword.

name: Ghirahim
title: The Demon Lord
description: The flamboyant, sadistic spirit of the Demon King's own sword, and Fi's dark counterpart, who spends Skyward Sword hunting Zelda in order to sacrifice her and resurrect his master, Demise.

name: Zant
title: Usurper King of Twilight
description: A Twili who usurped the Twilight Realm's throne from Midna with power granted by Ganondorf, plunging both the Twilight Realm and Hyrule into shadow before being struck down by Link and Midna in Twilight Princess.

name: Vaati
title: The Wind Mage
description: A mischievous Minish spirit corrupted by the power of the Picori Blade and Light Force, who becomes a recurring Wind Mage antagonist seeking to conquer Hyrule in the Four Sword era of games.

name: Skull Kid
title: Wearer of Majora's Mask
description: A lonely forest imp of Termina who steals Majora's Mask from a masked salesman, and, corrupted by the mask's malevolence, sets a moon on a collision course with Clock Town in Majora's Mask.

name: Rauru
title: Sage of Light
description: The last of the Sheikah in Ocarina of Time, who watches over the Temple of Time as its guardian sage and, awakened as the Sage of Light, guides Link and Zelda from the Chamber of the Sages.

name: Saria
title: Sage of the Forest
description: A Kokiri and Link's closest childhood friend in the Kokiri Forest, revealed to be the Sage of the Forest, who watches over him from the Sacred Forest Meadow through the Ocarina of Time.

name: Darunia
title: Sage of Fire
description: The Big Boss of the Goron tribe on Death Mountain, who befriends Link after he lifts a curse of famine, and later awakens as the Sage of Fire within the Fire Temple.

name: Princess Ruto
title: Sage of Water
description: The headstrong princess of the Zora, betrothed to Link by tradition after he rescues her from Lord Jabu-Jabu's belly, who later awakens as the Sage of Water within the Water Temple.

name: Nabooru
title: Sage of Spirit
description: A Gerudo thief who opposes Ganondorf's rule of her people, captured and brainwashed while investigating the Spirit Temple, before being freed by Link and awakening as the Sage of Spirit.

name: Daruk
wikipedia: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
title: Champion of the Gorons
description: The boisterous Goron Champion who pilots the Divine Beast Vah Rudania and shields Link with Daruk's Protection, killed defending his Divine Beast a century before Breath of the Wild before returning as a spirit to aid Link.

name: Mipha
wikipedia: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
title: Champion of the Zora
description: The gentle Zora Champion and princess who pilots the Divine Beast Vah Ruta and harbors a quiet love for Link, gifting him Mipha's Grace before falling to Calamity Ganon a century before Breath of the Wild.

name: Revali
wikipedia: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
title: Champion of the Rito
description: The proud, gifted Rito archer and Champion who pilots the Divine Beast Vah Medoh and grants Link Revali's Gale, resentful of Link's chosen status before ultimately proving his worth defending his Divine Beast.

name: Urbosa
title: Champion of the Gerudo
description: The formidable Gerudo chief and Champion who pilots the Divine Beast Vah Naboris and calls down lightning as Urbosa's Fury, a close friend of Queen Zelda's mother who watches over Princess Zelda in her youth.

name: Majora's Mask
title: The Cursed Mask
description: An ancient, malevolent mask of unknown origin once used in fearsome rituals, which possesses the Skull Kid after being stolen and drives him to bring the moon crashing down upon Clock Town over the course of three days.

name: The Great Deku Tree
title: Guardian of the Kokiri
description: The ancient, sentient tree spirit who watches over the Kokiri Forest and its child-like Kokiri inhabitants, and who, cursed by Ganondorf, sends Link on his first quest before succumbing to the curse.

name: The Great Fairies
title: Fountains of Blessing
description: Powerful, ancient fairy spirits dwelling in hidden fountains across Hyrule, who reward Link for restoring their shrines or defeating their guardians with magic upgrades, potions, and blessings.

name: Volvagia
wikipedia: List of The Legend of Zelda enemies
title: The Subterranean Lava Dragon
description: A massive fire dragon dwelling within Death Mountain's Fire Temple, once bound by the Goron Sages until it broke free and terrorized the Gorons, defeated by Link with the Megaton Hammer.

name: Gohma
wikipedia: List of The Legend of Zelda enemies
title: The Parasitic Armored Arachnid
description: A recurring giant, single-eyed spider-like boss that infests dungeons across the series, from the Great Deku Tree in Ocarina of Time to Hyrule Castle in Breath of the Wild.

name: Octorok
title: The Rock-Spitting Menace
description: One of the most enduring monster species in the franchise, an octopus-like creature that lurks in fields and shallow water, launching rocks at travelers who stray too close.

name: Moblin
title: The Spear-Wielding Brute
description: A recurring species of pig-like or dog-like humanoid monsters found throughout Hyrule, typically armed with spears or clubs and organized into camps that guard treasure or key roads.

name: Hyrule
title: The Kingdom of Hyrule
description: The central kingdom in which most of the series takes place, a land shaped by the Golden Goddesses and watched over by the Triforce, ruled by the royal family descended from the goddess Hylia.

name: Hyrule Castle
title: Seat of the Royal Family
description: The seat of Hyrule's royal family, a fortified castle standing at the heart of the kingdom, repeatedly besieged, corrupted, or overrun by Ganon across the series' many ages.

name: Temple of Time
title: Sanctuary of the Triforce
description: An ancient sanctuary holding the Door of Time and the Master Sword's pedestal, through which the hero passes between eras to draw the blade of evil's bane and confront Ganon.

name: Kokiri Forest
title: Home of the Kokiri
description: A secluded forest at the edge of Hyrule, home to the eternally youthful Kokiri and the Great Deku Tree, and the childhood home of Link in Ocarina of Time.

name: Death Mountain
title: The Volcanic Peak
description: A towering volcano overlooking Kakariko Village and Hyrule, home to the Goron tribe and the site of numerous dungeons including the Fire Temple and Divine Beast Vah Rudania.

name: Zora's Domain
title: Home of the Zora
description: The icy, waterfall-fed home of the aquatic Zora people, seat of their royal family and a recurring location across many games in the series.

name: Gerudo Desert
title: Land of the Gerudo
description: A vast, arid desert in the west of Hyrule, home to the all-female Gerudo tribe and their fortress, and the birthplace of Ganondorf, the only male Gerudo born in a century.

name: Kakariko Village
title: Village of the Sheikah
description: A quiet village at the foot of Death Mountain, historically home to the Sheikah, where Impa often shelters and raises Princess Zelda in secrecy.

name: Termina
title: The Cursed Parallel Land
description: A parallel land Link stumbles into through the Lost Woods, mirroring Hyrule in many of its faces and places, doomed to be destroyed by a falling moon in three days unless the Skull Kid is stopped.

name: Clock Town
title: Capital of Termina
description: The central capital of Termina, built around a great clock tower that counts down the three days before the moon's collision, and home to the Carnival of Time.

name: Twilight Realm
title: Realm of the Twili
description: A shadowy parallel realm banished from Hyrule long ago, home to the Twili people, whose throne is usurped by Zant with Ganondorf's power in Twilight Princess.

name: Skyloft
title: The Floating Refuge
description: A cluster of islands floating high above the clouds, home to a Hylian society who fled the surface generations ago and ride giant birds called Loftwings, and the starting point of Link's journey in Skyward Sword.

name: Sacred Realm
title: Realm of the Triforce
description: A hidden golden realm holding the Triforce, said to reflect the heart of whoever enters it, twisted into the Dark World when Ganondorf claims it unworthily in A Link to the Past.
